Docs/Configurations

Configurations

Keep the workspace, controller and observation contract fixed before comparing policies.

Four configuration layers

DexArena separates shared workstation geometry, robot embodiment, physics and control, and task-specific parameters. Change the task without silently changing the first three layers.

LayerCanonical contract
WorkspaceTable x +0.180 m; platform x −0.870 m; arm y ±0.220 m.
EmbodimentPanda arms with Sharpa hands for the released data and paper scores.
Simulation400 Hz physics, 20 Hz control; solver iterations 24 / 8; contact offset 1 mm.
TaskRegistered horizon, reset distribution, objects, stage transitions and persistent success predicates.

Query the registered profile

from utils.dex_scene_eval import registered_task_settings

settings = registered_task_settings("SharpaAngledClickMouse-v1")

Use the registry rather than copying a robot UID or horizon from another task. Source references: utils/dex_tasks.py, task/config/collection_targets.py and task/config/workspace_rig.py.

Actions and cameras

Sharpa single-arm actions have 29 targets: 7 arm joints followed by 22 hand joints. Dual actions have 58 targets ordered left arm, right arm, left hand, right hand. Targets are absolute joint positions in radians under pd_joint_pos.

The fixed policy camera rig uses 256 × 256 images. Optional runtime wrist cameras at 640 × 360 and 90° horizontal field of view are not an interchangeable leaderboard input. Observation widths vary by task.
